<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:background="#FF0A0E1A">
<!-- Gesamtzeit oben links --> <TextView android:id="@+id/tvElapsedTime" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginStart="24dp" android:layout_marginTop="20dp" android:fontFamily="monospace" android:text="0:00" android:textColor="#AA03DAC6" android:textSize="14sp" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" />
<!-- Zyklen-Zähler oben rechts --> <TextView android:id="@+id/tvCycleCount" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="20dp" android:layout_marginEnd="24dp" android:text="Zyklus 0" android:textColor="#AA03DAC6" android:textSize="14sp" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" />
<!-- Äußerer Glow-Ring (größer, sehr transparent) --> <View android:id="@+id/viewOuterGlow" android:layout_width="300dp" android:layout_height="300dp" android:background="@drawable/breathing_circle_outer" app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" app:layout_constraintVerticalBias="0.38" />
<!-- Innerer Atem-Kreis --> <View android:id="@+id/viewBreathCircle" android:layout_width="200dp" android:layout_height="200dp" android:background="@drawable/breathing_circle" app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="@id/viewOuterGlow" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="@id/viewOuterGlow" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="@id/viewOuterGlow" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="@id/viewOuterGlow" />
<!-- Emoji / Icon der Phase (über Kreis) --> <TextView android:id="@+id/tvPhaseIcon" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="" android:textSize="40sp" app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="@id/viewBreathCircle" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="@id/viewBreathCircle" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="@id/viewBreathCircle" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="@id/viewBreathCircle" app:layout_constraintVerticalBias="0.35" />
<!-- Countdown-Zahl (groß, mittig im Kreis unten) --> <TextView android:id="@+id/tvPhaseCountdown" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:fontFamily="monospace" android:text="–" android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF" android:textSize="42sp" android:textStyle="bold" app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="@id/viewBreathCircle" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="@id/viewBreathCircle" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="@id/viewBreathCircle" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="@id/viewBreathCircle" app:layout_constraintVerticalBias="0.72" />
<!-- Phasenname (unterhalb des Kreises) --> <TextView android:id="@+id/tvPhaseName" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="28dp" android:letterSpacing="0.15" android:text="VORBEREITUNG" android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF" android:textSize="22sp" android:textStyle="bold" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/viewOuterGlow" />
<!-- Kurze Beschreibung --> <TextView android:id="@+id/tvPhaseDesc" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" android:text="Mach es dir bequem …" android:textColor="#8803DAC6" android:textSize="13sp" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/tvPhaseName" />
<!-- 4-7-8 Hinweis (nur bei Vorbereitung sichtbar) --> <TextView android:id="@+id/tvRhythm" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="24dp" android:text="4 · 7 · 8 Atemübung" android:textColor="#4403DAC6" android:textSize="12sp" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/tvPhaseDesc" />
<!-- Stopp-Button unten --> <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton android:id="@+id/btnStopMeditation" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="48dp" android:paddingHorizontal="32dp" android:text="Meditation beenden" android:textColor="#FF0A0E1A" app:backgroundTint="#03DAC6" app:cornerRadius="24dp" app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" />
</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>
